text:
jen: Quick topic 0m: proposing a retention + KMS gating change for SIEM exports. Aim: limit raw-export blast radius, make long-term data accessible only through audited unwraps.

jen: Short proposal: 1) default raw external exports -> 90d retention; 2) move records older than 90d to anonymized tier (2y); 3) require KMS-unlock + ticket tag for raw-unwraps; 4) oncall emergency unwrap flow with short TTL.

omar: fyi legal already pinged me about e-discovery. Can we keep a 2y searchable index of metadata (no raw) so investigations still find events? :thinking_face:

li: +1 to metadata index. question: per-tenant CMK vs platform key with envelope-wrapped DEKs for each export? cost/ops tradeoffs.

jen: prefer platform master key + per-export DEK wrapped with metadata including tenant-id and ticket-id. allows single KMS policy but still per-export audit. if a customer provides CMK we can use that instead.

sam: emergency path concern: ops will need minimal friction during incidents. How does approval work? we can't ask for 3 approvals in a paged fire.

jen: emergency flow proposal: ops-bot issues short-lived unwrap token after: (a) MFA by requester, (b) one oncall approval, and (c) audit log entry created atomically. token TTL 10m. automated detection flows can request a pre-approved unwrap token for known playbooks. target < 45s.

omar: we need to ensure keys cannot be reused. Add a single-use request-tag condition. IAM condition idea: kms:CallerAccount == service-account AND aws:RequestTag/siem-ticket == <ticket-id> AND aws:EpochTime < <expiry>.

li: can you paste a minimal IAM-style condition snippet? infra likes to see exact phrases.

jen: paste below (informal):

```
Statement:
  Effect: Allow
  Action: kms:Decrypt
  Resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/siem-master
  Condition:
    StringEquals: {"aws:RequestTag/siem-ticket": "${ticket_id}"}
    Bool: {"kms:GrantIsForProvisionedService": "true"}
    NumericLessThanEquals: {"aws:RequestTimeout": "${expiry_unix}"}
```

sam: nice. also add require: aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent for human-triggered unwraps.

omar: migration plan for existing exports? we have millions of objects. what's the cheapest safe move?

jen: plan sketch: 1) catalogue exports by age + tenant, 2) auto-wrap any object >90d with archive DEK (read-only, very restricted), 3) add retention metadata and rotate storage class to glacier-equivalent where allowed, 4) notify tenants via support pipeline if we need consent for retention policy change.

li: testing: we should create a harness that does 3 things: verify unwrap audit entries are immutable, verify ticket linkage (siem-ticket tag), and verify short-lived token expiry. I can own this harness.

sam: ops-runbook updates needed: include commands to generate ops-bot token, escalation matrix, rollback (re-wrap with old DEK), and a post-unwrap quick-scan to alert on PII access. I'll revise runbook after harness done.

security-bot: Created ticket SECU-5134 and linked to https://redwood-internal/jira/SECU-5134

omar: legal/compliance ask: please include a config flag per-tenant to opt-in to extended raw retention for legal investigations with justification and TTL. some customers will need 2y raw.

jen: agreed. design will include per-tenant retention overrides gated by legal approval and audit trail. that will create a special retention label stored with export metadata.

li: quick note about observability: add a per-tenant metric for unwrap_count and unwrap_latency so we can detect unusual access patterns.

sam: devops: we should enforce a daily digest of unwraps to security lead and to the tenant's security contact.

jen: scheduling: i'll add to Wed security sync and invite compliance + legal + platform + oncall. next steps: draft RFC, infra IAM PR, test harness, and runbook. target rollout window: next sprint (feature-flagged).

omar: thumbs-up. please tag me on the RFC for CMK edge cases.

jen: tl;dr done. any objections?

li: none from me.

sam: none. will prep runbook.

jen: thanks all. dropping notes in SECU-5134 and linking the draft design: https://redwood-internal/docs/security/siem-retention-gating-draft

security-bot: SECU-5134 status updated: triage -> in-progress

sam: noted. :white_check_mark:
